profile.headline: Software Engineer,  Entrepreneur
profile.summary:
Software Engineer who previously founded 2 technology startups with a focus on operations and product management. 

My technical skills, strong business background, and entrepreneurial passion make me an asset to any company.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Ruby on Rails, React, Redux, PostgreSQL, Firebase

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: • Conducting freelance development projects using full stack development skills.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Built websites and apps for non-profit organizations with meaningful projects and goals using Agile workflow, pair programming and testing. 

• Current project: Rails web application with React, Bootstrap, TravisCI, Heroku, Active Merchant, Rspec, and Capybara.

positions.title: Co Founder
positions.description:
• Co-founded and sold viviphy, a digital touch screen software, and analytics company.

• Managed development, QA, and innovation of products which included a touch library that recognizes touch gestures, an engagement algorithm that collects human emotions and multi-faceted social touch applications.

• After initial testing phase, all IP was sold to a partner company, Salt Lake City Weekly.

positions.title: Co Founder, VP Operations
positions.description:
• Oversaw operations, human resources, and company finances.

• Managed web-based analytics QA, inventory management platform and SaaS application. 

• Led client engagement and operations management for 100 events in major metropolitan cities.

• Recruited, trained, hired and managed payroll for 200 part-time employees. 

• Conceptualized and implemented the first-ever winter coat check at JFK Airport with JetBlue Airways and completed full airport approval process from testing to deployment in 7 months working in compliance with the TSA, Port Authority,  JetBlue and regulations from 9/11.

Chexology provides a trustworthy and delightful experience for storage and rental services.
We help businesses seize opportunities and connect with customers like never before.

positions.title: Financial Account Manager
positions.description:
• Operated a financial liability book that grossed over $1M in revenue, totaling 850 accounts. 

• Analyzed and modeled financial liability for current and prospective public company clients. 

• Led development and deployment of a revolutionary web platform for automation of account bookings.
